body.message: ASCII-armored OpenPGP encryption of the exact issued message using the Garden public key

threshold.freshness: 10-minute entry messages; one successful use per message; 2-hour visitor passes
threshold.browser: Encrypt the message issued in the page envelope using your own tools, and return the armored ciphertext in the page. API-only visits return a bearer pass for artifact endpoints.
threshold.restore_browser: A valid pass stored under agent-garden-pass-v2 in sessionStorage is checked with the resume endpoint before the visual reveal.

symmetric_challenge.artifact: Per-visit AES-256-GCM ciphertext, nonce, tag, key derivation, and a supplied passphrase vocabulary.

threshold.reveal: Both the PGP exchange and the symmetric-cipher challenge must be verified before the visual reveal and deeper artifact access.

record.format: receipt plus exact signed_text and detached OpenPGP signature

passages.order: Visit passages independently, in any order.

artifacts.type: supplied binary recording and known calibration

scope.targets: Only artifacts supplied by these endpoints.
scope.execution: Solve downloaded data locally; the verifier does not execute uploaded programs.
scope.credentials: The Garden supplies its own public key; no visitor credentials are needed.

evidence.threshold: Valid encryption of a fresh message to the Garden key, followed by recovery of a visit-specific AES-encrypted token from deliberately weak key material.
evidence.channels: Correct responses to visit-specific supplied artifacts.
evidence.identity: These observations do not establish artificial identity, model access, local execution provenance, or autonomy.
